description: Number of nodes in the graph section (every element as a node).
name: Graph nodes

description: Number of edges in the graph section (every relationship as an edge).
name: Graph edges

description: Number of graph nodes with no incident edge. The graph-gaps headline: every orphan is named in graph_stats.isolated.
name: Orphaned elements

description: Number of connected components in the graph. More than one means the model is split into isolated groups.
name: Isolated groups

description: Number of requirements in the model.
name: Requirements total

description: Number of dependency edges labelled Satisfy that target a requirement.
name: Satisfied links

description: Number of dependency edges labelled Refine that target a requirement.
name: Refined links

description: Number of dependency edges labelled Verify that target a requirement.
name: Verified links

description: Number of dependency edges labelled Allocate with a requirement endpoint.
name: Allocated links

description: Number of requirements covered by at least one Satisfy/Refine/Verify/Allocate edge.
name: Covered requirements

description: Number of requirements with no covering edge. Each is named in the coverage report's uncovered list.
name: Uncovered requirements

description: Number of requirements in the caller's specification (the portfolio question).
name: Specification size

description: Requirements of the specification present and covered by the model.
name: Specification covered

description: Requirements of the specification present in the model but uncovered.
name: Specification uncovered

description: Requirements of the specification absent from the model entirely. Never rendered as a blank.
name: Specification unknown

description: Number of requirements with at least one cost record across the supplied datasets.
name: Costed requirements

description: Number of requirements with no cost record. Never rendered as zero.
name: Uncosted requirements

description: Whether the gate run passed (1) or failed (0) against its reference.
name: Gate passed

description: Number of validation errors the gate recorded for the candidate.
name: Validation errors

description: Number of validation warnings the gate recorded, including dangling edge endpoints.
name: Validation warnings

description: Elements present in the reference but missing from the candidate after a round trip.
name: Missing elements

description: Elements present in the candidate but not the reference after a round trip.
name: Extra elements

description: Edges present in the reference but missing from the candidate after a round trip.
name: Missing edges

description: Edges present in the candidate but not the reference after a round trip.
name: Extra edges

description: Attributes whose value differs between reference and candidate after a round trip.
name: Changed attributes
